payload.reason: The evidence provides clear insights into how different variants of ROUGE scores correlate with manual evaluations, particularly in the context of scientific summarization.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in varying correlation values with human judgments, indicating that not all ROUGE scores are equally effective.
ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 show better correlations with manual evaluations compared to other variants like ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L, which have weak correlations.
The proposed metric Sera achieves higher and more consistent correlations with manual evaluations than ROUGE variants, highlighting the limitations of ROUGE for scientific summarization.
